newsitem.title: UK: UK M0 falls to s/a 25.156 bln stg week to May 28.
newsitem.headline: UK M0 falls to s/a 25.156 bln stg week to May 28.

text.p: British M0 money supply fell to a provisional seasonally adjusted 25.156 billion stg in the week to May 28 from 25.350 billion stg the previous week, the Bank of England said on Monday.
On an unadjusted basis, M0 rose to 25.455 billion stg from 25.326 billion the week before.
Notes and coins in circulation edged up to 25.129 billion stg from 25.119 billion on an adjusted basis and rose to an unadjusted 25.428 billion stg from 25.095 billion the week before.
